_comment: Sidecar for network.log. Records which lines a human would judge to match the query below. Line numbers are 1-indexed, matching jevtail's --json "lineno" field. Tests build their mock TypeSafe responder from this file so the mocked judgments track human expectation instead of a hardcoded keyword rule.

matching_reasons.3: en0 link state changed to DOWN
matching_reasons.7: DHCP lease failure, no address obtained

non_matching_reasons: cron, backup, ssh login, user login, disk mount, spotlight indexing, log rotation, clock sync, software update check, bluetooth pairing, battery/power state -- none are network connectivity problems
